headline: ATL @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.71 at MIA 3.28, with a projected total of 7.99. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: ATL moved +0.54 runs while MIA moved -0.17, changing the projected margin by +0.71 runs. The projected total climbed +0.36, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -10.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Chris Sale has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Xavier Edwards, Drake Baldwin, Otto Lopez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Esteury Ruiz, Christopher Morel because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
